body:
**🟡 Medium · bug**

Splitting into independent `action` / `modelAction` / `grantAction` removes the previous global `action.isPending` guard, so mutations against the same connection can now run concurrently (e.g. Save model while Disconnect/Reconnect is in flight, or Revoke while auth is pending). This risks PUT vs disconnect/revoke races on the same row and inconsistent `savedModel`/grants UI. Consider including `action.isPending` in model/grant disabled states (and vice versa).

**Suggested change**

```diff
--- original
+++ suggested
@@ -1 +1 @@
-        <Button type="submit" disabled={modelAction.isPending || !model.trim() || model === savedModel}>
+        <Button type="submit" disabled={modelAction.isPending || action.isPending || !model.trim() || model === savedModel}>
```

<!-- code-mortis:finding:d7f2437e-d517-492c-b8b4-edf2f8474152 -->

**🟡 Medium · bug**

Same stale-closure pattern as installations menu: `editing`/`deleting` are still null when `onCloseAutoFocus` runs after `onSelect`, so focus is not trapped for the dialog. Prevent by default or track pending dialog in a ref updated synchronously.

**Suggested change**

```diff
--- original
+++ suggested
@@ -1 +1 @@
-<DropdownMenuContent align="end" onCloseAutoFocus={(event) => { if (editing || deleting) event.preventDefault(); }}>
+<DropdownMenuContent align="end" onCloseAutoFocus={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); }}>
```

<!-- code-mortis:finding:5525db0f-bf16-4bc3-a4e0-b74ab999360d -->

**🔵 Low · maintainability**

Badge never shows a checking state for manual/background refetches: `accountStatus` uses `auth.isPending` (true only before first data with `useQuery`), while `Check status` disables on `auth.isFetching` (true on every poll/refetch, see `useApi` with `poll=true`). Manual checks therefore disable the button with no badge change, and `pending` value has no spinner/style in `Status` (only `queued/running/in_progress` spin). Also a failed refetch with cached `status` (e.g. `connected`) keeps showing stale `Connected`. Consider `isFetching` for the badge and explicit error handling.

**Suggested change**

```diff
--- original
+++ suggested
@@ -1 +1,3 @@
 function accountStatus(status: string | undefined, pending: boolean, failed: boolean) {
+  if (pending) return { value: "running", label: "Checking account\u2026" };
+  if (failed) return { value: "failed", label: status ? `Could not refresh account (last: ${status})` : "Could not check account" };
```

<!-- code-mortis:finding:27d85664-7441-486e-8ac5-74d92d00cb41 -->

**🟡 Medium · bug** Status flickers to "Checking account…" on every background poll. `auth` polls every 5s (`useApi(..., true)`), so `auth.isFetching` is true briefly on each interval and `accountStatus` forces `running`. Use initial-load state instead, e.g. `auth.isPending` or `auth.isFetching && !auth.data`. Same reason `Check status` button flickers disabled every poll interval. **Suggested change** ```diff --- original +++ suggested @@ -1 +1 @@ -
+
```

**🔵 Low · maintainability**

`@apply sr-only` inside `@container settings` couples markup to Tailwind build processing and container support. With Tailwind v4 (@tailwindcss/vite) verify `tsc -b && vite build` still expands it; if not, inline plain sr-only CSS so labels remain accessible when containers are unsupported (fallback already relies on `.settings-cell-label{display:block}`).

<!-- code-mortis:finding:f4b1fa7e-ff3b-47c0-a3ea-fa673863b800 -->

**🟡 Medium · bug**

Same stale-closure pattern as installations: `editing/deleting` (and `member/removingMember` below) are still null in the closure when onSelect sets them and the menu closes, so focus is returned to the trigger before the Dialog takes focus. Use a synchronously-updated ref for pending dialog intent instead of state in both DropdownMenuContent onCloseAutoFocus handlers.

**Suggested change**

```diff
--- original
+++ suggested
@@ -1 +1,3 @@
-                          <DropdownMenuContent align="end" onCloseAutoFocus={(event) => { if (editing || deleting) event.preventDefault(); }}>
+const pendingDialog = useRef<boolean>(false);
+// in onSelect: pendingDialog.current = true; setEditing(connection);
+<DropdownMenuContent align="end" onCloseAutoFocus={(event) => { if (pendingDialog.current) event.preventDefault(); }}> // reset to false on dialog open/close
```

<!-- code-mortis:finding:cfca3699-8eed-4641-9779-aa8d342547b3 -->
